title: Fernanda Castillo Stars in 'Alicia's Law' | Watch the Trailer Now
summary: Based on 'The Good Wife' created by Robert King & Michelle King, Part 1 arrives on November 11 and Part 2 on December 9.
body_markdown:
Sometimes it’s okay for things to never be the same again…


A series about reinventing oneself, power, and new beginnings. Coming to Netflix in two parts: Part 1 arrives on November 11 and Part 2 on December 9.


After 20 years away from practicing law, Alicia must rediscover a part of herself she had put on hold and find a new balance between her professional life, her family, and what she wants for herself.


Throughout the series, legal cases intertwine with family drama, friendship, relationships, and romance, as Alicia faces new challenges that will test her experience as a lawyer and lead her to question the decisions she has made. With mystery, excitement, and suspense,


Alicia's Law


follows its protagonist as she forges her path toward a new life—this time, on her own terms.

About


Alicia's Law


DIRECTORS:


Ana Lorena Pérez Ríos, José Ramón Chávez Delgado


SCREENPLAY BY:


Fernanda Eguiarte, Jimena Gallardo, Itzel Lara, Patricia Ordaz Cruz, Carlos Trujano


BASED ON:


The Good Wife


CREATED BY:


Robert King & Michelle King


PRODUCTION DESIGN:


Victoria Cuevas


EXECUTIVE PRODUCTION:


Ángela Suárez, Samuel Duque, María Fernanda Henao, Karina Blanco


PHOTOGRAPHY:


Luis Ávila, Ignacio Prieto Palacio Amc


CAST:


Fernanda Castillo (Alicia), Michel Brown (David), Karina Gidi (Diana), Juan Manuel Bernal (Aurelio), Yoshira Escárrega (Katya), Darío Yazbek (Alex), Karla Gaytán (Greta), Axel Madrazo (Iker), Patricia Bernal (Jaqui), María Penella (Sofía), Francisco Rubio (Paco), Anita del Rey (Nuria), Juliette Pardau (Pilar).


SYNOPSIS


Alicia watches her life come undone when her husband, Aurelio, is found guilty and imprisoned for corruption, after videos surface implicating him in a sex scandal. With her family under public scrutiny, she decides to return to the legal profession after 20 years and rebuild her career to move forward. As she tries to reclaim her professional standing and support her teenage children in this new reality, Alicia begins to question what she wants out of life. A reunion with a past love and changes in her relationship with Aurelio will force her to make a decision: return to the life she once knew, or build a new one on her own terms.
